title: VM/PageBacked v1 completion
summary: Bridge VM/PageBacked from current ~45% structure / ~30% behavior toward ~85% on both, leaving only items that the active design docs explicitly defer (rmap, hugetlb, userfaultfd, in-place mprotect, reclaim policy, writeback scheduling) or that depend on Process/ThreadRuntime ownership (fork_aspace, exec_aspace, trap page-fault dispatch).

write_sets.notes: Single-owner during initial implementation. When parallel slices fan out, each worker claims a disjoint subset (vm/structure vs vm/execution vs page_backed core vs page_backed lifecycle) via its own worktree record.

steps.title: Refresh vm-doc-gap-ledger to post-resync state
steps.notes: Captured as a dated follow-up note (2026-05-04-vm-pagebacked-gap-update.md) rather than mutating the prior 2026-05-03 ledger snapshot. Notes new useraccessif/irqif HAL surfaces and points at this plan as the new active mitigation order.

steps.title: Wire useraccessif into step_read/step_write byte transfer
verification: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --exclude tx-kernel-riscv64-qemu-virt --exclude tx-kernel-riscv64-m1dock-mock --exclude tx-kernel-loongarch64-qemu-virt -- -D warnings
steps.notes: PAGE_BACKED §5.1/5.2 byte-accurate transfer. Use newly-merged useraccessif HAL trait. Add host-test backing so step_read/step_write tests can assert byte equality without QEMU. Keep copyless fast path for in-kernel ranges; user-buffer path goes through useraccessif.

steps.title: Implement mock FsPageBacking covering File-variant materialize_page
steps.notes: PAGE_BACKED §6 is currently an interface shell. Provide a mock backing that supports fetch/flush/truncate/metadata so File-variant tests exercise the dispatcher end-to-end. No ext4/devfs/bdev-fs work in this step.

steps.title: Add step_fallocate for File variant
steps.notes: PAGE_BACKED §5.5. Reject for Anon/Device per spec. Grow PC.size without pre-materializing pages. Backing-first commit, then publish visible size.

steps.title: Wire PC.size into VM fault SIGBUS-style checks
steps.notes: Currently called out as the next step in STATUS.md. Reject faults beyond visible PC.size with the documented SIGBUS shape; keep capacity-bound check separate.

steps.title: Byte-accurate partial-page truncate and growth
steps.notes: PAGE_BACKED §5.1/5.2/5.3 partial-page byte handling. Zero past-EOF tail on truncate-grow inside last page; partial reads/writes at the EOF page; no full-page materialization for purely metadata growth.

steps.title: Confirm StepOutcome carries wait tokens fault paths can yield through
steps.notes: STEP_MODEL_v1 wait-aware StepOutcome contract. Audit current shape; if missing, extend with Wait(WaitToken)/Blocked variants the script wrappers can observe. No behavior change for existing callers.

steps.title: Wrap resolve_fault as async fault_script with reservation drop on wait
steps.notes: VM §5.1 + §3.6 cross-async-wait discipline. Drop the Materializer reservation across PageBacked wait, re-acquire on resume, revalidate recipe before publication. Synchronous resolve_fault stays as the inner step.

steps.title: Wrap mmap helpers as async mmap_script
steps.notes: VM §5.2. ExclusiveWriter reservation, recipe insert/replace, pmap reserve_map. No semantic change; the inner sync helpers stay as compatibility surface.

steps.title: Async wrappers for munmap, mprotect, mremap
steps.notes: VM §5.3/5.4/5.5. Same shape as mmap_script. Mremap stays in disjoint-only mode for v1; overlapping is documented v1 debt.

steps.title: brk_script over the existing AddressSpace mapping primitives
steps.notes: VM §5.8. Models the brk region as an Anon mapping that the script grows/shrinks; no Process dependency for the in-VM portion.

steps.title: Observation-only scripts: madvise, msync, mincore
steps.notes: VM §5.9. madvise treats MADV_WILLNEED as no-op per §9.7; msync delegates to PageBacked step_fsync where applicable; mincore reads the pmap walk surface (which §10 below extends).

steps.title: Extend VmPmap with walk and protect-without-teardown for mincore + future fork CoW demotion
steps.notes: Adds the bare pmap walk needed by mincore and the protect-without-teardown surface required by fork CoW demotion later. Does not implement in-place retag (§9.8 deferred); demotion is via tear-down then refault per §3.4 of the existing design.

steps.title: Replace BTreeMap snapshot publication with persistent/epoch range index
steps.notes: VM §1.2 publication rule + INVARIANTS_v4 ARCH-5. Replace cloned BTreeMap publication under a small mutex with a persistent epoch-snapshot range index, expose IdentRef-shaped guard-scoped witnesses to vm::checks, retire vm::checks staged-witness shims. Largest single structural step; can be parallelized with the script wrappers above.

steps.title: splice / sendfile / copy_file_range over PageBacked variants
steps.notes: PAGE_BACKED §9. Match-on-both-ends dispatch over Anon/File/Device. File-File path uses mock backing for tests; Device path documents zero-copy intent.

steps.title: Reflink + CoW-on-write scaffolding inside PageContainer share rules
steps.notes: PAGE_BACKED §7. Wire share/CoW counters on the PageContainer side; full reflink across two RNodes still waits on a real backend with refcount support. Document the §12.4 reflink-vs-truncate race as deferred.

steps.title: Final ledger + STATUS update; verify completion bar
steps.notes: Restate completion at >=85% on structure and behavior. Name remaining gaps explicitly: fork_aspace/exec_aspace/trap-dispatch (Process-blocked), reclaim policy and writeback scheduling (v1-deferred), reverse mapping/hugetlb/userfaultfd/in-place-mprotect/mlock optimization (deferred). Add a dated decision note that closes this plan.

verification.command: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --exclude tx-kernel-riscv64-qemu-virt --exclude tx-kernel-riscv64-m1dock-mock --exclude tx-kernel-loongarch64-qemu-virt -- -D warnings

risks: wait-aware-step-outcome may force StepOutcome shape changes that ripple into reactor and other subsystems; keep the change narrow and additive.
persistent-epoch-recipes is a foundational rewrite; it can land in parallel with script wrappers but conflicts with vm/checks staged witnesses must be resolved deliberately.
user-buffer-byte-copy depends on the host-test side of useraccessif; if the host harness lacks a usable mock, add one before tightening byte-equality assertions.
Each script wrapper risks duplicating reservation/revalidation logic; factor a shared helper once two wrappers exist.
blockers: fork_aspace, exec_aspace, and trap page-fault dispatch are explicitly out of scope: they require Process ownership of Cap<AddressSpace> and ThreadRuntime authority paths.
Concrete VFS backends (ext4, devfs, bdev-fs) are out of scope; mock FsPageBacking is the substitute.
PAGE_BACKED §8 reclaim policy and §12 open questions are deferred by the design docs.
